extracted.intended_audience: Applicants and agents filing PCT international applications and requesting supplementary international search (patent attorneys, agents, and applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and documentary requirements and operational rules for preparing, filing, and processing a PCT supplementary international search request and for how the International Bureau and Authorities handle such requests and reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the international application contains disclosure of one or more nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences required to be included in a sequence listing pursuant to Annex C of the Administrative Instructions, the applicant, if so required, should furnish a copy of the sequence listing (complying with the prescribed standard in a language accepted by that Authority) to the International Bureau together with the supplementary search request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a sequence listing is not furnished in an accepted language, the Authority may invite the applicant to submit one and may limit the search to the extent a meaningful search can be carried out without it (see paragraphs 7.005–7.012 and 8.040).

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of international application (Box I)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant should clearly identify the international application by its international application number, international filing date and title, as provided for in Box No. I. If a new title has been established by the International Searching Authority, that title should be indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the prescribed date format (refer to paragraph 5.061); when multiple priority claims exist, indicate the earliest priority filing date as the priority date; a file reference (≤25 characters) may be added (see paragraph 5.017).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority date indication
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the international application claims the priority of several earlier applications, the filing date of the earliest application whose priority is claimed should be indicated as the priority date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include priority details consistently with Box I and apply the correct date formatting conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant identification (Box II)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant should be identified by name and address in Box No. II. The requirements for these indications are the same as those for the request form (PCT/RO/101).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where there are multiple applicants, only one needs to be indicated for the purposes of requesting supplementary search; it is recommended to indicate the applicant who will represent all applicants and receive notifications (see paragraphs 5.025–5.034).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant e-mail for notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: If an e-mail address is indicated in Box No. II of the supplementary search request form, the International Bureau, and the Authority specified for supplementary search (if it provides such a service), will send notifications in respect of the international application to the applicant by e-mail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Usually no paper notifications will be sent unless the Authority additionally chooses to send them. If an agent/common representative has provided an e-mail, notifications will only be sent to the agent/common representative. Applicants must keep e-mail details up-to-date and ensure incoming e-mails are not blocked; changes should be requested to be recorded (preferably directly at the IB) under Rule 92bis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment of agent (Box III / power of attorney)
rubrics_metrics.description: The appointment of an agent for procedures during the international phase, including before the Authority specified for supplementary search, may be made in Box No. IV of the request form (PCT/RO/101) or in a separate power of attorney submitted to the receiving Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If appointing an agent specifically for the Authority specified for supplementary search, indicate that in Box No. III of the supplementary search request form and sign the form. Indications must include agent name and address; telephone, fax and e-mail are recommended. If agent is registered with the Office acting as Authority, include the registration number. Separate or general powers may need to be submitted/deposited with the Authority; Authorities may waive this requirement (see paragraphs 5.041–5.046, 11.001–11.014 and Annex SISA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent e-mail for notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: If an e-mail address is indicated in Box No. III, the International Bureau and the Authority specified for supplementary search (if it provides such a service) will send notifications to the agent or common representative at the indicated e-mail address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No paper notifications will usually be sent if e-mail is used, unless the Authority chooses additionally to send paper notifications. If no e-mail provided or agent chooses postal mail, notifications will be sent exclusively by postal mail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address for correspondence rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an agent is appointed specifically for the purposes of the procedure before the Authority specified for supplementary search, all notifications issued by that Authority will be addressed only to that agent. Otherwise, correspondence will be sent to the previously appointed agent or common representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no agent/common representative is appointed and the applicant wants correspondence sent to a different address than Box II, indicate that address in Box No. III and mark the last check-box; do not mark the last check-box if 'agent' or 'common representative' check-boxes are marked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language basis for supplementary search (Box IV)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant should indicate the language for the purposes of supplementary international search in Box No. IV and whether that language is that of the international application as originally filed or of any translation furnished to the receiving Office under Rule 12.3 or 12.4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If neither the original nor the furnished translation is accepted by the Authority specified for supplementary search, a translation into a language accepted by that Authority must be furnished with the request and the last language check-box should be marked. Where more than one language applies, the applicant may indicate which language version is to form the basis of the supplementary search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of inventions to be searched (when lack of unity found)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the International Searching Authority has found non-compliance with unity of invention, the applicant may choose which invention among several to be searched by the Authority specified for supplementary search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To limit the supplementary search to an invention other than the main invention, mark the last check-box in Box No. IV and state corresponding claim numbers. If the ISR is available to the Authority before it starts, it may exclude from the search any claims not subject of the main ISR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the check list (Box V)
rubrics_metrics.description: Box No. V should be completed by the applicant to allow the International Bureau to verify the completeness of the documents accompanying the supplementary search request and to check whether a translation and a sequence listing, where indicated, are actually received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the checklist to reduce processing errors and speed verification (refer to paragraph 8.025).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature requirement (Box VI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary search request must be signed by one of the applicants or by the appointed agent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional signatures may be required for withdrawal of the supplementary search request (see paragraphs 11.048–11.061).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes to the supplementary search request form
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notes are intended to facilitate completion of the form and outline, in relation to each Box, what indications are required and how they are to be made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notes are not required to be submitted with the supplementary search request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee calculation sheet usage
rubrics_metrics.description: The fee calculation sheet is intended to help the applicant calculate the total amount of fees payable to the International Bureau and is usually annexed to the supplementary search request form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is strongly recommended to complete and submit the sheet to help the IB verify fee calculations and identify errors; Notes to the sheet provide details on completion (see paragraph 8.028 and 5.184–5.199 for payment info).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees payable for supplementary international search
rubrics_metrics.description: Two fees must be paid: (i) the supplementary search fee for the Authority specified for supplementary search; and (ii) the supplementary search handling fee for the International Bureau.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The supplementary search fee varies by Authority and is fixed in its agreement with the IB (see Annex SISA and ISA/IPEA agreements). The supplementary search handling fee is fixed by the PCT Assembly and listed in the Schedule of Fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee reduction eligibility for handling fee
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant may be entitled to a 90% reduction of the supplementary search handling fee if a natural person and national/resident of a State meeting specified GDP and filing thresholds, or a national/resident of a least developed country; each applicant must satisfy the criteria if several applicants exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant must be the true and only owner at filing and not under obligation to assign/transfer/license to an ineligible party. The reduction applies based on name, nationality and residence in Box II without need for a specific request; list of eligible States provided by IB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for payment of fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Both the supplementary search fee and the supplementary search handling fee must be paid to the International Bureau within one month from the date of receipt of the supplementary search request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not paid in full within that time limit, a late payment fee will become due. If fees remain unpaid, the IB will consider the request not to have been submitted (see Forms PCT/IB/376 and PCT/IB/377).

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency for fee payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment of fees will only be accepted in Swiss francs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refunds of fees in certain circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: If, before the IB transmits relevant documents to the Authority, the international application is withdrawn or considered withdrawn, or the supplementary search request is withdrawn or considered not to have been submitted, IB will refund both fees; if before the Authority has started the search the request is considered not to have been submitted, that Authority will refund the supplementary search fee in accordance with its agreement with IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refunds follow Rules 45bis.2(d), 45bis.3(d) and 45bis.3(e) and the Authority's agreement with IB.

rubrics_metrics.name: IB initial checks on receipt of request
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon receipt, the International Bureau will check whether the request was received within the prescribed time limit (before expiration of 22 months from the priority date) and whether the Authority specified is competent and not the ISA that carried out the main search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requirements not complied with, IB will declare the supplementary search request not to have been submitted and notify the applicant using Form PCT/IB/379 (see paragraph 8.033).

rubrics_metrics.name: IB defect-checking and invitation to correct
rubrics_metrics.description: IB will check whether the request clearly indicates name and address of at least one applicant and of the agent (if any), the title, the international filing date and the international application number, and whether a translation is needed and furnished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any requirement not complied with, IB will invite the applicant to correct defects within one month using Form PCT/IB/378 (see paragraph 8.034).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure if fees not paid in full at IB check
rubrics_metrics.description: If fees are not paid in full and the one-month time limit has not expired, IB will invite payment using Form PCT/IB/376. If the one-month time limit has expired, IB will issue Form PCT/IB/377 inviting payment together with a late payment fee equal to 50% of the supplementary search handling fee, payable within one month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicant fails to pay, the request will be considered not submitted (see paragraph 8.035).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences of failure to correct defects or pay fees
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant fails to correct defects or does not pay the fees in full before expiration of the respective time limit, the supplementary search request will be considered not to have been submitted, and IB will make a declaration and notify the applicant using Form PCT/IB/379.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This follows Rule 45bis.4(d) and related paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for transmission of documents to Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Once IB finds that preceding requirements have been complied with, it will transmit the relevant documents to the Authority specified for supplementary search promptly after it receives the international search report, or after the expiration of 17 months from the priority date, whichever occurs first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If some documents are still not available, IB will promptly transmit them once available (see paragraph 8.037).

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents transmitted by IB to Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: IB will transmit to the Authority a copy of each applicable document: (i) the supplementary search request, (ii) the international application, (iii) any sequence listing furnished, (iv) any translation to be used as basis, (v) the international search report and the written opinion (including English translation), (vi) any invitation by the ISA to pay additional fees concerning unity, and (vii) any protest by the applicant against the ISA's opinion and the decision thereon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all applicable documents are provided to IB so Authority receives full dossier (Rules 45bis.4(e)–(f)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority start-of-work timing
rubrics_metrics.description: On receipt of the relevant documents from IB, the Authority specified for supplementary search should promptly begin its work, but may postpone start until it receives the ISR and written opinion; work must commence promptly after the expiration of 22 months from the priority date regardless.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Absence of ISR/written opinion will be noted on the supplementary ISR (see paragraph 8.039).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct submissions to Authority and excluded amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should furnish required documents to IB with the supplementary search request for transmission by IB; any amendments filed under Article 19 or 34 will not be taken into account by the Authority specified for supplementary search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a sequence listing complying with prescribed standard in an accepted language was not submitted to IB, the Authority will invite submission directly; failure may result in limited search (see paragraph 8.040).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority limitations/conditions that exclude search
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Authority finds that carrying out the supplementary search is entirely excluded by a limitation or condition in its Agreement with IB (other than Article 17(2) limitation), it will declare the request not to have been submitted and notify applicant and IB; if not entirely excluded, it may restrict the search to certain claims and indicate this in the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Authority's Agreement (ISA/IPEA agreements and Annex SISA) for the scope and any exclusions (see paragraph 8.041).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority may refuse to search certain claims
rubrics_metrics.description: The Authority is not obliged to conduct a supplementary search on some or all claims that it would not search in a main search and on claims not searched by the main ISA; if it is not obliged to search any claims it will declare that no supplementary ISR will be established and notify applicant and IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes subject matter outside Authority's remit or claims previously not searched by main ISA (Article 17(2)(a); see paragraph 8.042).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of supplementary international search
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary international search shall cover at least the documentation indicated in the Agreement between the Authority acting as specified for supplementary search and the International Bureau; scope may vary by Authority (all PCT documentation plus other patent/technical documents or documentation in certain languages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Authority's listing in the ISA/IPEA agreements and Annex SISA for exact coverage (see paragraph 8.043).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of main ISA unity finding on supplementary search
rubrics_metrics.description: If the main ISA finds lack of unity and the applicant did not pay additional search fees, the Authority specified for supplementary search is not obliged to carry out supplementary search on claims not searched by the main ISA; however, the Authority may reach its own finding on unity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See paragraphs 5.114–5.123 for unity requirements; Authority may disagree with main ISA (see paragraph 8.044).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority opinion on lack of unity and review right
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Authority considers the application does not comply with unity, it will establish the supplementary ISR on the parts relating to the main invention, notify the applicant of its opinion and reasons, and the applicant may request a review within one month subject to payment of any review fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review fee refunded if opinion found entirely unjustified; a revised supplementary ISR will be issued where appropriate (see paragraphs 8.045–8.046 and Annex SISA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review procedure constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: A review of the Authority's opinion on unity may not be carried out only by the person who made the decision being reviewed; the result will be notified to the applicant, and remedies (full or partial) described apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If opinion entirely unjustified, ISR established on all parts and review fee refunded; if partially unjustified, a corrected ISR may be issued. Applicant may request that review request and decision be communicated to designated Offices along with the ISR (see paragraph 8.046).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary ISR establishment time limit
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary international search report must be established within 28 months from the priority date using Form PCT/SISA/501.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no supplementary ISR will be established, a declaration must be made within 28 months using Form PCT/SISA/502 (see paragraphs 8.047–8.048).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contents and differences of supplementary ISR
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary ISR is generally similar in contents and appearance to the main ISR but does not contain comments on the title or the abstract, nor classification; it does not repeat prior art already cited unless necessary because of new relevance, and may contain more detailed explanations concerning citations and comments on scope of the supplementary search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional detail is common because no written opinion accompanies the supplementary ISR; further comments are relevant when supplementary search was done without the main ISR (see paragraph 8.049).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of copies of cited documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Many Authorities transmit copies of documents cited in the supplementary ISR automatically and without extra charge; Annex SISA indicates whether an Authority charges a fee for furnishing copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult Annex SISA to know the Authority's practice and any charges (see paragraph 8.050).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmission of supplementary ISR to applicant, IB and designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.description: The Authority will, on the same day, transmit one copy of the supplementary ISR (or declaration of no ISR) to the IB and one copy to the applicant. The IB will include the supplementary ISR in its communication to each designated Office as if it were part of the international search report, unless the designated Office has waived this requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure designated Offices receive the supplementary ISR via IB; this affects national/regional processing (see paragraph 8.051).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmission of supplementary ISR to International Preliminary Examining Authority (IPEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a demand for international preliminary examination has been filed and the IPEA is not the same Authority as that specified for supplementary search, the IB will promptly transmit a copy of the supplementary ISR to the IPEA; the report will be taken into account during international preliminary examination, unless the IPEA has already begun drafting its report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing matters: if IPEA has already started drawing up the international preliminary examination report, it need not take the supplementary ISR into account (see paragraph 8.052).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and public availability of supplementary ISR
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary ISR is not published per se nor as part of the international publication. However, once the international application has been published and the supplementary ISR has been received, it is made available for public inspection by the International Bureau on PATENTSCOPE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be aware that the ISR becomes publicly accessible on PATENTSCOPE after international publication and receipt of the supplementary ISR by IB (see paragraph 8.053).
